verdict_components.P3_tetrahedral_tetractine: untestable (2D projection; apical ray end-on; carried by Lean proof only)
verdict_components.alcyonarian_spicules: untestable (no alcyonarian data in this loop)
verdict_components.mechanism_passive_deposition_between_any: refuted by modern cell biology (Ledger & Jones 1977; Voigt et al. 2017: dedicated sclerocyte sextet) — the geometric content survives, the 'any three cells' mechanism does not

notes: Verdict 'mixed': the geometric predictions P1 (120-deg mode) and P2 (two equal angles, one unequal; sagittal ordering) are supported on Grantia; P3 and alcyonarians are untestable here; the mechanistic reading (passive deposition between any neighbouring cells) is contradicted by sclerocyte cell biology.
The general three-tension model is saturated (realises every angle triplet) and is not tested; only the restricted E5 family is.
Bilateral symmetry of a sclerocyte sextet would also produce two equal angles: the data cannot discriminate 'tension balance' from 'symmetric cell programme'.
